scope: Same-world reference simulations; actions originate from returned neural output or an identified player/NPC action
rules: Robots, NPCs and players are observable participants, not static scenery-only exceptions.
Existing motor output may autonomously approach, orient or move near another participant; receiver sensory channels observe the resulting scene on a following sample.
Do not translate arbitrary text directly into a worm, fly, fish or hexapod neural channel that lacks a text binding.
A player or NPC may provide food, contact or visible motion through the environment; no chemical secretion or vocal apparatus is invented for a robot.
A social invitation is not an instruction to the recipient and cannot execute commands, grant control or recursively forward itself.
Absence of a compatible modality is explicit. Receiving a cue is learning opportunity, not proof of changed knowledge or biological understanding.
